# Sheep & Wolves

> A free, real-time social deduction party game played on everyone's phones, in person or remotely — no app download required.

Sheep & Wolves is a browser-based party game for 3 to 30 players, in the same tradition as Werewolf or Mafia. One player hosts a game and shares a short code or QR code; everyone else joins from their own phone's browser. Roles are dealt secretly — most players are sheep, a hidden few are wolves. Each round, the player holding the question card picks a discussion prompt and reads it aloud, choosing whether to aim it at one player, a few people, or the whole group. The group discusses out loud — face to face, or over the game's built-in voice chat if playing remotely — then votes each round to eliminate a suspected wolf. Sheep win once every wolf has been voted out; wolves win if they ever equal or outnumber the remaining sheep.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sheepandwolves.app/): Overview and entry point to host or join a game.
- [How to Play](https://sheepandwolves.app/how-to-play): Full rules, round-by-round walkthrough, and FAQ (setup, player counts, wolves knowing their teammates, directing questions at players, playing in person or remotely, the question-asker's private vote record, tiebreakers, win conditions).
- [Host a Game](https://sheepandwolves.app/create): Create a new game and configure player count, wolf count, and discussion timer.
- [Join a Game](https://sheepandwolves.app/join): Join an existing game using a code or QR code.

## Notes

- Free to play, no account or app download required.
- Plays in person or remotely — everyone uses their own phone for roles and voting, and can talk face to face or through the game's built-in voice chat.
- Each round's question can be directed at a specific player, a few players, or opened up to the whole group.
